description: This file defines the ErrorMessageHelper class, which provides numerous static methods for generating detailed error message strings used in testing or validation within the Apache Fineract project. It appears to serve as a centralized utility for consistent error reporting related to loan processing, transactions, journal entries, and other financial data validation scenarios.

classes.name: ErrorMessageHelper
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to generate detailed error messages for various validation and error reporting scenarios in the Fineract project.
